definition: Covers material u means every candidate satisfying the specified material predicate is a part of u. It does not assert that every candidate is material, that all beings belong to this domain, or that u explains its parts.
note: Analyst scope profile for #328, motivated by the materialized Varzi exposition. All-subset quantification is an explicit second-order mathematical choice; neither causal sufficiency nor metaphysical adequacy is attributed to the source. See docs/notes/universal-fusion-grounding.md.
